card.name: The -ly ending of adverbs
card.fires_on: The final -ly or -ally piece that completes an adverb split into parts, such as Centr|ally, vigorous|ly, humb|ly or local|ly. It appears in both medical labels and general web text.

modes.label: Drug-class adverbs
modes.description: The -ally ending of 'Centrally' in lists of centrally acting drugs.

modes.label: Manner or degree adverbs
modes.description: The -ly ending completing an adverb in instructions or prose.
modes.example: DO NOT SHAKE or SWIRL VIGOROUS<<LY>>. Do not remove the contents
